title: Invertibility of the integer single direct-image unit
statement: Let $g:T\to S$ be a scheme map, $q\in\mathbf Z$, and $M$ an $\mathcal O_T$-module. Let $S_X^q(N)$ denote the complex with sole coefficient $N$ in degree $q$, and let $u:S_S^q(g_*M)\to Rg_*(S_T^qM)$ be the single direct-image comparison [lem-weil-pbc-integer-single-adjunction-transpose]. Then $H^q(u)$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: cohomology.tex Tags 0BKJ (lemma-sheafification-cohomology), 0D5X (lemma-unbounded-describe-higher-direct-images), 079W (lemma-adjoint); derived.tex Tag 0156 (section-right-derived-functor). The kernel/cokernel and unit calculations are agent-derived.

proof.text: The normalized degree-zero single unit composed with the zeroth-derived-functor isomorphism is the standard single/homology isomorphism. Cancel the isomorphism to obtain invertibility of H0 of the unit.

The canonical right-derived unit commutes with integer shifts. Shift the degree-zero single by -q, transfer invertibility through the homology shift isomorphism, and use naturality along the single-shift isomorphism. The additional map in the definition of u is already an isomorphism.
